output.answer_markdown: The U.S. trade accounts receivable securitization facility's interest rate is based on the asset-backed commercial paper rate, which was 4.58% plus 0.75% at December 31, 2022 [1]. The combined rate at that date was 5.33% [2]. The average outstanding balance under the facility during 2022 was approximately $166 million [3]. Based on that average balance, each hypothetical 25 basis point increase in rates would have increased interest expense under the facility by $0.4 million [4][5].
